reply_text:
I told Hollis in a reply to his message in #central-team: the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 382 seats. Tobias posted that figure in the same channel on Oct 14, and Hollis is a member there.

I couldn't check gbrain first. It refused the search because its access token isn't tied to any member, so nothing was read from it. Fixing that needs an admin on the brain host to link the token to a member with `gbrain auth rescope`. I didn't make that change.
